title: Web client: contact list
description:
Implement contact list in app.js: fetch all contacts via Contact/get and render them in the sidebar.

What: Call Contact/get, render contact display names in sidebar, clicking a contact opens or creates a chat.

Algorithm:
1. async function fetchContacts():
   - const responses = await callJmap([['Contact/get', { accountId: 'a-self', ids: null }, 'c0']]);
   - const [, result] = responses[0];  // ['Contact/get', result, 'c0']
   - if (result.type) throw new Error(result.type);  // method-level error
   - return result.list;  // array of Contact objects
2. function getContactName(contact):
   - return (contact.displayName && contact.displayName.trim()) || contact.login || contact.tailscaleUserId;
3. function renderContactList(contacts):
   - const ul = document.getElementById('contact-list');
   - ul.innerHTML = '';  // safe: we only set textContent on children
   - for each contact:
     - const li = document.createElement('li'); li.className = 'contact-item';
     - const span = document.createElement('span'); span.textContent = getContactName(contact);  // textContent NOT innerHTML
     - li.dataset.contactId = contact.id;
     - li.appendChild(span);
     - li.addEventListener('click', () => openOrCreateChat(contact));
     - ul.appendChild(li);
4. async function openOrCreateChat(contact):
   - Find existing chat: look in current chats state for one whose participants includes contact.id
   - If found: selectChat(chatId)
   - If not found: POST Chat/set create with { contactId: contact.id } then selectChat(new id)

Defensive programming rules:
- Always use textContent, never innerHTML for contact names (attacker-controlled).
- Fall back display name order: displayName → login → tailscaleUserId (never empty).
- On Contact/get error: show error banner, do not crash.
- contact.id equals contact.tailscaleUserId (opaque — never parse or format).

Tests (oracle: known Contact object shapes from the JMAP spec + kith-chat/src/contact.rs Contact struct):
- Given a contact with displayName='Alice', renders 'Alice' in the list
- Given a contact with displayName=null and login='alice@example.com', renders 'alice@example.com'
- Given a contact with displayName=null and login='', renders tailscaleUserId
- Clicking a contact when no chat exists triggers Chat/set create
